description: Spawn-event branches of 1024 summoned zombie pigmen. One pigman is summoned and `execute as @e[type=zombie_pigman] at @s run summon minecraft:zombie_pigman ~ ~ ~` doubles them ten times inside a sealed barrier box 400 blocks from the player (out of the client's view); `testfor` then counts them by family. The definition's `minecraft:entity_spawned` randomizes spawn_adult (weight 9500), spawn_baby (425) and spawn_baby_jockey (75); spawn_baby_jockey is not declared, and a pigman that draws it gets no component group, so no family at all.
server: BDS 1.26.51 (plain bedrock_server, no Endstone), seed 12345 harness world
